SELECT
          id,
          name,
          type,
          status,
          currency,
          balance_amount,
          debt_balance_amount,
          credit_limit_amount,
          institution_name,
          description,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        FROM accounts
        ORDER BY name ASC;

SELECT * FROM transactions INDEXED BY idx_transactions_date
     WHERE account_id = ? AND payment_method = ? ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC;
SELECT * FROM recurring_subscriptions;
SELECT * FROM subscription_occurrences WHERE status IN ('pending','overdue') OR expected_date >= ? OR id = ? OR transaction_id = ?;
SELECT * FROM subscription_reminders WHERE delivery_status != 'delivered' OR occurrence_id IN (SELECT id FROM subscription_occurrences WHERE expected_date >= ?);
SELECT * FROM smart_alerts WHERE related_entity_type IN ('subscription','subscription_occurrence');
SELECT id,type,status,currency FROM accounts;
SELECT id,type FROM categories;
SELECT id,category_id,is_active FROM subcategories;
SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE id = ? OR id IN (SELECT transaction_id FROM subscription_occurrences WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL);

SELECT id, amount, date, civil_date, account_id, target_account_id, type, direction, status
     FROM transactions INDEXED BY idx_transactions_date
     WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND (
       (type = 'expense' AND direction = 'outflow' AND account_id IN (?,?))
       OR (type = 'creditCardPayment' AND (account_id IN (?,?) OR target_account_id IN (?,?)))
     )
     ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC;

SELECT
          id,
          transaction_id,
          account_id,
          merchant_name,
          total_amount,
          currency,
          installment_count,
          paid_installments,
          monthly_amount,
          first_due_date,
          status,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        FROM installment_purchases
        WHERE account_id IN (?, ?)
        ORDER BY created_at DESC;
